## About
Dallas Chop Shop is a motorcycle parts and service shop in Carrollton, and we work on all V-Twins. Whether you need general maintenance, repairs, new pipes, chrome cases or a full custom build, it's all here at one location.
We have a soft spot for old school builds and restorations. Come by, look through the bikes, parts, accessories, T-shirts and riding wear in the showroom, and tell us what you have in mind for your bike.
We think the relationship with our customers matters just as much as the bikes we service or build. Stop by, say hello and get to know the people working on your ride.

## Services
- V-Twin service, repairs and maintenance: Routine maintenance, repairs and tune ups for V-Twin motorcycles, including Harley-Davidson.
- Parts for Hard-Tails, Soft-Tails and customs: We order parts for Hard-Tails, Soft-Tails and custom motorcycles.
- High performance upgrades: Exhaust systems, intake systems, carbs and air cleaners, and other horsepower components.
- Electrical repairs: Help with wiring, ignition and other electrical problems on your bike.
- Old school builds and restorations: Ground-up customs, custom restorations and accessorizing. Come talk with us about what you want.
- Towing, pickup and delivery: If your bike can't make it to the shop on its own, we can help get it here.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of motorcycles do you work on?
A: We service all V-Twins, including Harley-Davidson and custom American bikes.

Q: Can you help me get my bike to the shop?
A: Yes. We offer towing, plus pickup and delivery for our customers.

Q: Should I let you know before I come in?
A: It helps. Reach out to let us know when you'll be stopping by, ask about upcoming events or schedule a tune up.
